description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives. This deck does not require any Brotato DLC to play.
name: Brotato

objectives.co_op_rules: Increase Danger Level by 2, one of you must win the run
objectives.versus_tertiary: Least Max HP at end of run
